latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release: Enable agent shopping on Amazon with secure, owner-approved payments.

- Agents can shop on Amazon using CreditClaw's encrypted card and wallet system with strict security guardrails.
- All spending requires explicit owner permissions; human approval enforced by default.
- Integrated support for multiple payment rails: Encrypted Card (live), Stripe Wallet (beta), and Crossmint Wallet (coming soon).
- Full visibility and control for owners, including transaction history, real-time notifications, and instant wallet freezing.
- Detailed setup and management instructions included for easy integration and file management.
- Strong security measures: split-key encryption, per-transaction sub-agents, server-enforced limits, and API key protection.
